# Carbon Capture (CarbonCapture_Amine)

> **Class**: `CarbonCapture_Amine` | **Module**: `energysim.models.carbon` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Post-Combustion Chemical Absorption Amine CO2 Capture System.

Quasi-static specific-consumption model: captured CO2 = inlet x capture
rate; reboiler heat and electrical parasitics scale linearly with captured
mass. No solvent inventory, column dynamics or part-load penalty. Validity:
steady loads, capture rate 0.8-0.95.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'CarbonCapture'` | - | - |
| `capture_rate_nom` | `float` | `0.9` | - | Nominal CO2 capture efficiency (typically 90%). |
| `spec_steam_reboiler_gj_tco2` | `float` | `3.0` | GJ/tCO2 | Thermal energy required in reboiler per ton of CO2 captured (GJ/tCO2). |
| `spec_elec_kwh_tco2` | `float` | `120.0` | kWh/tCO2 | Electrical auxiliary consumption for blowers, solvent pumps, and compressors. |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `m_dot_CO2_in_t_hr` | t/h | - |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `m_dot_CO2_captured_t_hr` | t/h | - |
| `P_elec_parasitic_MW` | MW | - |
| `Q_steam_reboiler_MW_th` | MW | - |

## Validity and notes

Validity:
steady loads, capture rate 0.8-0.95.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import CarbonCapture_Amine

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('carboncapture_amine', model=CarbonCapture_Amine(), outputs=['m_dot_CO2_captured_t_hr', 'P_elec_parasitic_MW', 'Q_steam_reboiler_MW_th'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['carboncapture_amine'].tail(2))
```
